lints.name: authenticated_security_definer_function_executable
lints.title: Signed-In Users Can Execute SECURITY DEFINER Function
lints.description: Detects `SECURITY DEFINER` functions that are callable by signed-in users. Revoke `EXECUTE`, switch the function to `SECURITY INVOKER`, or move it out of your exposed API schema if signed-in users should not call it.

findings.detail: Function `public.lockliel_course_cutover_status()` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/lockliel_course_cutover_status`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.lockliel_course_gates()` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/lockliel_course_gates`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Function `public.lockliel_sample_media(expected_user uuid, target_asset uuid, position_seconds numeric, playing boolean)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/lockliel_sample_media`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

metadata.name: lockliel_sample_media
metadata.arguments: expected_user uuid, target_asset uuid, position_seconds numeric, playing boolean
